NVDA.title: NVIDIA and IREN Announce Strategic Partnership to Deploy up to 5 Gigawatts of AI Infrastructure
NVDA.content: NVIDIA and IREN intend to deploy next-generation AI infrastructure across IREN's global data center pipeline. IREN issued NVIDIA a 5-year right to purchase up to 30M shares at $70/share ($2.1B potential equity investment).

NVDA.title: NVIDIA and Corning Announce Multiyear Partnership to Expand U.S. Optical Manufacturing 10x for AI Infrastructure
NVDA.content: Corning to increase U.S. optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10x and U.S. fiber production by 50%+, building 3 new facilities in North Carolina and Texas, creating 3,000+ jobs.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Earnings Preview: Analysts Expect $78.8B Revenue on May 20
NVDA.content: Wall Street expects $78.8B revenue and $1.77 EPS for Q1 FY2027 (ends April 2026). Stock up ~15% YTD but underperforming Intel and AMD. Earnings scheduled May 20.

NVDA.title: Congress Advances AI OVERWATCH Act to Restrict Blackwell Chip Sales to China, Iran, Russia for 2 Years
NVDA.content: House Foreign Affairs Committee advanced the AI OVERWATCH Act, treating NVDA Blackwell chip exports like weapons sales; would prohibit sales to entities of concern (China, Iran, NK, Russia, Venezuela) for 2 years. Direct regulatory risk for NVDA.

NVDA.title: NVIDIA Ships First Vera Rubin Samples; DeepSeek Blackwell Violation Heightens Export Scrutiny Ahead of May 20 Earnings
NVDA.content: NVIDIA shipped first Vera Rubin architecture samples to customers this week — successor to Blackwell delivering up to 10x lower inference token cost and 4x fewer GPUs needed to train MoE models. Separately, Reuters reported DeepSeek trained its latest model on Blackwell chips in apparent export control violation, intensifying Washington regulatory scrutiny ahead of NVDA's May 20 Q1 FY2027 earnings ($78.8B revenue guide).

AVGO.title: Wall Street Shifts AI Chip Focus Away from Nvidia and Broadcom Toward Intel, AMD, Micron
AVGO.content: Investors rotating from premium-priced NVDA/AVGO toward cheaper AI chip plays. Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue hit $8.4B last quarter (+106% YoY), guiding $10.7B next quarter; CEO targets $100B AI sales by 2027.

AVGO.title: Bernstein: AI Agent Demand Drives Chip Demand 'Off the Charts'; Broadcom Custom ASIC Among Key Beneficiaries
AVGO.content: Bernstein analyst notes AI agent proliferation driving chip demand 'off the charts.' Broadcom's hyperscaler ASIC business (Google TPU, Meta MTIA) and network switching chips are structural beneficiaries as supply struggles to keep up.

AVGO.title: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 Preview: $22B Revenue Guidance (+47% YoY), AI Semiconductor Revenue to Reach $10.7B (+140%); Earnings June 3
AVGO.content: Broadcom Q2 FY2026 earnings scheduled June 3, 2026. Q2 revenue guided at $22B (+47% YoY), AI semiconductor revenue expected $10.7B (+140% YoY). CEO Hock Tan targets $100B AI chip revenue by 2027. AI revenue backlog $73B. AVGO shares up 115% YoY and 23% YTD as hyperscaler ASIC (Google TPU, Meta MTIA) and network chip demand accelerates.

AMD.title: AMD Q1 2026 Earnings: Revenue $10.3B (+38% YoY), Data Center $5.8B (+57%); Q2 Guide $11.2B
AMD.content: AMD Q1 2026: total revenue $10.3B (+38% YoY), Data Center $5.8B (+57% YoY) on Instinct GPU and EPYC CPU momentum. Non-GAAP EPS $1.37. Q2 guidance $11.2B ±$300M (~46% YoY growth). Strong inference deployment ramp across cloud and enterprise.

AMD.title: Meta to Deploy up to 6 Gigawatts of AMD Instinct GPUs Including Custom MI450-Based Accelerators
AMD.content: Meta announced plans to deploy up to 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs; first 1GW deployment utilizes a custom MI450-based GPU developed in partnership with AMD. Largest single AMD Instinct customer commitment announced.

AMD.title: Goldman Sachs and Bernstein Upgrade AMD to Buy After Blockbuster Q1 and Strong Q2 Guidance
AMD.content: Goldman Sachs and Bernstein upgraded AMD to Buy citing AI GPU demand acceleration and EPYC server CPU share gains from Intel. AMD shares surged 14%+ post-earnings as Wall Street diversifies AI chip exposure.

AMD.title: AMD Launches Instinct MI350P PCIe: 144GB HBM3E, CDNA4 Architecture for Enterprise On-Prem AI on Existing Servers
AMD.content: AMD launched Instinct MI350P, its first PCIe-based Instinct accelerator in 4 years: dual-slot air-cooled form factor, 144GB HBM3E at 4TB/s, peak 4,600 TFLOPS at MXFP4, 600W TBP. Enables enterprise AI deployment on existing air-cooled servers without major infrastructure upgrades. Dell expanded on-prem AI platform with MI350P support. CDNA4 architecture targets agentic AI inference workloads.

INTC.title: 美国政府持有 Intel 9.9% 非投票权股权 — CHIPS Act 拨款转股权
INTC.content: 美国政府将 Intel 剩余 CHIPS Act 拨款转为 9.9% 非投票权股权, 433M 股, 标志着政府成为唯一一家美国先进制程公司的实质股东。

INTC.title: Intel 18A (1.8nm) Fab 52 亚利桑那量产 — 美国本土首次先进节点 HVM
INTC.content: Intel Fab 52 (亚利桑那 Ocotillo) 18A 工艺进入 HVM, 首次美国本土实现先进制程量产, 战略意义对冲 TSMC 集中风险。

INTC.title: Intel 收到 $5.7B 加速 CHIPS Act 拨款
INTC.content: 经修订的 CHIPS Act 协议加速 $5.7B 拨款。Intel 仍独立运营 Foundry, 政府不参与运营决策。

INTC.title: NVDA-Intel 战略合作 — 老对手联手
INTC.content: Nvidia 和 Intel 达成战略合作, AI 生态新格局。

INTC.title: Intel Q1 2026 Blowout: Revenue $13.58B vs $12.42B Estimate; DCAI +22% to $5.1B; Stock +20% After-Hours
INTC.content: Intel Q1 2026: revenue $13.58B (vs $12.42B est), adj EPS $0.29 (vs $0.01 est). Data Center & AI (DCAI) +22% to $5.1B. Q2 guide $13.8-14.8B vs $13.07B est. Intel 18A-based Xeon 6 in full volume production — fastest new product ramp in 5 years. Sixth consecutive quarter beating expectations.

INTC.title: Wall Street Sees 'Changing of the Guard in AI' as Intel Doubles YTD While Nvidia Lags
INTC.content: Intel has more than doubled in value in 2026, leading AI chip sector. Xeon 6 CPU demand running ahead of supply. Investors rotating into INTC from NVDA on valuation and execution turnaround narrative.

INTC.title: Apple Confirms Intel 18A Foundry Agreement to Manufacture Entry-Level Mac/iPad Chips in U.S.; INTC Surges 14%
INTC.content: Bloomberg confirmed Apple entered foundry agreement with Intel to manufacture 18A-based chips for entry-level Mac and iPad product lines — a landmark validation of Intel Foundry Services as a competitive alternative to TSMC. INTC surged ~14% on the news. Validates CEO Lip-Bu Tan's pitch: Intel 18A is the most advanced process node manufactured in the U.S., with yields running ahead of internal projections.

INTC.title: Intel Computex 2026 Preview (June 2): Panther Lake Handhelds, 52-Core Nova Lake Desktop, 288-Core Clearwater Forest Server — All on 18A
INTC.content: Intel's Computex 2026 lineup (June 2 keynote, Taipei): Panther Lake Arc G3 gaming handhelds, Nova Lake 52-core desktop preview, and 288-core Clearwater Forest server — all built on Intel 18A. Entire lineup serves as foundry showcase to potential customers Apple, Amazon, and Musk's Terafab. CEO Tan keynote positions 18A as U.S.-made alternative to TSMC for advanced AI chip production.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Q2 FY2026 Beats: Revenue $10.6B, EPS $2.65; Automotive First Time Exceeds $5B Annualized Rate
QCOM.content: QCOM Q2 FY2026: revenue $10.6B, EPS $2.65, both clearing consensus. Automotive segment first time exceeding $5B annualized revenue. Initial data center silicon shipments to a leading hyperscaler in December 2025. Stock rose ~15%.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Shares Up 6% on New Snapdragon X2 PC Platform with 85 TOPS NPU; AI PC Race Heats Up
QCOM.content: Qualcomm launched Snapdragon X2 PC platform with 85 TOPS Hexagon NPU, outperforming Intel Pinter Lake by ~30%. Targets always-on agentic AI PC experiences. Data center silicon shipment to hyperscaler adds new growth vector.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Authorizes $20B Share Buyback; Confirms First Data Center Processor Shipments to Hyperscaler in December 2025
QCOM.content: Alongside Q2 FY2026 earnings beat, Qualcomm authorized $20B share buyback program. CEO Cristiano Amon confirmed initial data center processor shipments already completed to a leading hyperscaler in December 2025, establishing data center as a new revenue vector. Automotive segment exceeded $5B annualized revenue for the first time. Stock surged 15% post-earnings.

QCOM.title: Qualcomm Hits All-Time High $247.90 (+9% on May 11); 42% 5-Day Rally on Data Center Entry + Tariff Relief; Leads Nasdaq 100
QCOM.content: QCOM surged 9% on May 11 to intraday all-time record $247.90, extending a 42% gain over 5 consecutive trading days. Catalysts: hyperscaler data center silicon shipments confirmed; 90-day US-China tariff suspension boosting smartphone demand; analyst upgrades (Daiwa Outperform $225, Tigress $280, Benchmark $225). QCOM led both S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 in performance on the day.

MRVL.title: Marvell Crushed April 2026: Custom AI Silicon at $1.5B Run Rate, Projected to $9-11B in 2026; NVIDIA $2B Partnership
MRVL.content: Marvell custom silicon business reached $1.5B annual run rate in FY2026, scaling to $9-11B projected for 2026. $2B NVIDIA strategic investment validates technology. High-volume production commenced for two major hyperscale AI customers in early 2026.

MRVL.title: Marvell Stock Surges on Google AI Chip Deal and 50+ New Custom ASIC Design Engagements
MRVL.content: MRVL up 84%+ YTD driven by custom silicon ramp for Google TPU and other hyperscalers. Over 50 new custom AI chip design engagements across 10+ customers. Data center revenue 73% of total mix at $1.519B last quarter.

MRVL.title: Marvell Acquires Polariton Technologies to Advance AI Data Center Optical Connectivity to 3.2T and Beyond
MRVL.content: Marvell acquired Polariton Technologies, a developer of high-speed low-power plasmonics-based silicon photonics devices. Terms undisclosed. Adds advanced modulation enabling continued scaling from 1.6T toward 3.2T+ optical connectivity, strengthening Marvell's end-to-end portfolio across ASIC, switching, electro-optics, and photonics for next-generation AI data center architectures.

MRVL.title: Marvell Up 67% in April Alone: Alphabet ASIC Co-Development Confirmed, Nvidia $2B Investment, Custom Silicon at $1.5B Run Rate
MRVL.content: MRVL surged 67% in April 2026 on three catalysts: confirmed Alphabet co-development agreement for custom AI ASIC, $2B Nvidia strategic investment validating technology, and custom silicon reaching $1.5B annual run rate (projected $9-11B for calendar 2026). Over 50 new design engagements across 10+ customers; data center now 73% of revenue mix at $1.519B last quarter.

APP.title: AppLovin Q1 2026: Revenue $1.84B (+59% YoY), Net Income $1.21B (+109%); Q2 Guidance $1.93B at 84% EBITDA Margin
APP.content: APP Q1 2026: revenue $1.842B (+59%), net income $1.206B (+109%), adj EBITDA $1.557B (+66%), FCF $1.3B. Q2 guidance revenue $1.93B, EBITDA $1.63B (84% margin). Repurchased 2.2M shares for $1B. Morgan Stanley reiterates Overweight at $720.

APP.title: AppLovin Announces June Public Launch of Axon Platform; Consumer Vertical April Revenue at Record Highs
APP.content: AppLovin to publicly launch Axon advertising platform in June 2026, targeting expansion beyond mobile gaming. Consumer vertical March spend +25% vs January; April at record highs. Gaming ad revenue +44% YoY in Q2 guide.

TSM.title: US-Taiwan Trade Deal: TSMC Arizona Investment Expands to $465B; 11 Fabs Planned Under 15% Tariff Framework
TSM.content: US-Taiwan trade deal caps tariffs on Taiwanese goods at 15%. TSMC plans to expand Arizona investment from $165B to $465B, adding 5 more fabs for 11 total. N2 and A16 processes included. Second fab P2 equipment move-in target: October 2026.

TSM.title: TSMC and Applied Materials Partner at $5B EPIC Center to Accelerate AI Chip Co-Innovation
TSM.content: TSMC and Applied Materials will co-innovate at AMAT's $5B EPIC Center in Silicon Valley to advance materials engineering and process integration for energy-efficient AI chips, accelerating lab-to-fab transitions for next-gen nodes.

ASML.title: ASML Q1 2026: Net Sales €8.8B; 2026 Guidance Raised to €36-40B; High-NA EUV Enters High-Volume Manufacturing
ASML.content: ASML Q1 2026: net sales €8.8B (+13% YoY), net income €2.8B (+17%). 2026 guidance raised to €36-40B (from €34-39B). EUV revenue €4.1B (+28% YoY). Backlog €38.8B. China fell to 19% of system sales. High-NA EUV entering high-volume manufacturing.

ASML.title: ASML CEO: EUV Supply Cannot Meet Demand Through 2027; Targeting 80 Low-NA Systems in 2027
ASML.content: ASML CEO stated EUV supply will not meet demand in foreseeable future. Plans to ship 80 Low-NA EUV systems in 2027. AI infrastructure build-out represents binding constraint at equipment layer. Stock rose 3.48% on earnings day.

ASML.title: US MATCH Act (April 2, 2026): Bipartisan Bill to Ban DUV Exports and Servicing to China — Major Risk to ASML China Revenue
ASML.content: The MATCH Act proposes banning DUV immersion lithography exports and servicing to Chinese chipmakers (SMIC, Hua Hong, Huawei, CXMT, YMTC). China was 33% of ASML's 2025 revenue. Bill includes 150-day window for allied (Netherlands, Japan) cooperation before U.S. unilateral action. ASML shares fell on the April 7 announcement. Bill still requires Congressional passage; company guided China to ~20% of 2026 revenue.

AMAT.title: Applied Materials and TSMC Partner at $5B EPIC Center to Accelerate AI Chip Technologies
AMAT.content: Applied Materials and TSMC will co-innovate at AMAT's $5B EPIC Center in Silicon Valley to advance materials engineering, equipment innovation, and process integration for next-era AI chips from data center to edge.

AMAT.title: Bernstein: AI Agent Demand Drives Equipment Demand 'Off the Charts'; AMAT, ASML at Maximum Capacity
AMAT.content: Bernstein analyst: binding constraint for AI chip capacity has shifted from chip design to foundry production and semiconductor equipment. TSMC, ASML, and AMAT all running at maximum capacity; supply cannot meet AI demand.

KLAC.title: KLA Corp Gains 2.9% as AMAT-TSMC EPIC Center Partnership Signals Sustained Equipment Supercycle
KLAC.content: KLAC gained 2.89% following AMAT-TSMC EPIC Center announcement. Measurement and inspection tools are critical for AI chip yield at 3nm/2nm nodes. KLA running at maximum capacity alongside AMAT and ASML.

KLAC.title: TSMC and ASML Post-Earnings Signal Semiconductor Equipment Makers Like KLAC Are Key AI Bottleneck
KLAC.content: Following TSMC and ASML Q1 earnings, analysts note the binding constraint for AI chip capacity has shifted to equipment makers like ASML, Lam Research, and KLA. All running at maximum capacity to meet AI infrastructure buildout demand.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Q1 2026: Revenue $292M (+10% Sequential); Advanced Packaging Revenue to Grow >50% in 2026
ONTO.content: ONTO Q1 2026 revenue $292M exceeded high end of guidance across all metrics. Dragonfly G5 initial commercial shipments and qualification at leading 2.5D logic customer. Advanced packaging (HBM/2.5D) expected to grow >50% in 2026. Full-year revenue growth >30% expected.

ONTO.title: Onto Innovation Announces $710M Strategic Investment for 27% Stake in Rigaku for AI-Enhanced X-Ray Metrology
ONTO.content: ONTO announced $710M strategic investment in Rigaku, acquiring 27% stake. Partnership integrates AI Diffract software into Rigaku X-ray metrology platforms to address advanced packaging inspection demands at HBM and CoWoS nodes.

SNPS.title: Synopsys Q1 FY2026 Earnings: Revenue $2.41B (+66% YoY) on Ansys Integration; Non-GAAP EPS $3.77, Backlog $11.3B
SNPS.content: SNPS Q1 FY2026: revenue $2.409B (+66% YoY), Design Automation $2.0B (+96%), non-GAAP EPS $3.77. Backlog $11.3B. Ansys integration progressing with joint solutions expected H1 2026 and monetization in FY2027.

SNPS.title: Elliott Management Takes Stake in Synopsys; Stock Down 23% From 52-Week High Despite EDA Dominance
SNPS.content: Elliott Management disclosed a stake in Synopsys while SNPS trades 23% below 52-week high. Activist involvement could accelerate strategic changes. Company unveiled AgentEngineer (2-5x EDA productivity) and Electronics Digital Twin Platform at Converge 2026.

MU.title: Micron Q2 FY2026 Record: Revenue $23.9B (+196% YoY); HBM4 2026 Supply Fully Contracted; Q3 Guide $33.5B at 81% GM
MU.content: MU Q2 FY2026: revenue $23.9B (+196% YoY), GAAP EPS $12.07. Q3 guidance: revenue $33.5B, gross margin ~81%. Entire 2026 HBM4 output sold out via binding contracts. Demand exceeds supply for all DRAM and NAND. Quarterly dividend increased 30%.

MU.title: Micron Stock Surges 15% to $746 on AI Memory Supercycle; HBM Now >30% of Total DRAM Revenue
MU.content: MU stock surged 15% to $746 as HBM supply stays sold out. HBM now >30% of total DRAM revenue vs <5% in 2022. Cantor Fitzgerald: 'structural supercycle for memory driven by AI workloads requiring an order of magnitude more memory per compute unit.'

MU.title: Micron Stock Up 700% Over Past Year; AI Memory Demand Still Far Outpacing Production Capacity
MU.content: MU shares up 700%+ over trailing 12 months driven by HBM3E and AI server DRAM demand. Micron executives confirmed demand for both DRAM and NAND far exceeds current supply capacity. Analysts see shares as relatively undervalued given earnings trajectory.

SNDK.title: Sandisk Q3 FY2026: Revenue $5.95B (+97% Sequential), GAAP EPS $23.03; Enterprise SSD Surges 233%
SNDK.content: SNDK Q3 FY2026: revenue $5.95B (beat $4.7B consensus by wide margin), GAAP net income $3.615B, EPS $23.03. Enterprise SSD +233% sequential on AI data center demand. Over $11B in enforceable financial guarantees from 5 new supply agreements; $42B total revenue backlog from 3 new contracts.

SNDK.title: Sandisk Stock Up ~500% in 2026; QLC Stargate Launch Ready; High-Bandwidth Flash NAND on Track for Late 2026
SNDK.content: SNDK has surged ~500% in 2026 driven by AI data center NAND demand. QLC Stargate launch readiness confirmed. High-bandwidth flash NAND targeted for late 2026. BiCS 8 recognized as industry gold standard. CEO: 'fundamental inflection point' for the company.

SNDK.title: Mizuho Raises Sandisk Price Target to $1,625 from $1,220 (Outperform); AI Data Center Storage Demand Remains Structural
SNDK.content: Mizuho raised SNDK price target to $1,625 from $1,220 (Outperform rating maintained), citing continued structural AI data center NAND storage demand. SNDK shares trading ~$1,543 (up ~500% in 2026). Q3 FY2026 enterprise SSD revenue surged 233% sequentially; company holds $42B total revenue backlog from recent hyperscaler supply contracts; BiCS8 recognized as industry gold standard.

COHR.title: Coherent Q3 FY2026: Revenue $1.81B, Non-GAAP EPS $1.41; Datacenter Revenue +41% YoY to $1.36B
COHR.content: COHR Q3 FY2026: non-GAAP EPS $1.41 (vs $1.39 consensus), revenue $1.81B. Datacenter & Communications +41% YoY to $1.36B, now 75% of total revenue. Coherent orders booked through 2028. Shares fell 10% on broad optical sector selloff despite beat.

COHR.title: Optical Sector Selloff: Coherent -10%, Lumentum -7%, Fabrinet -8% Despite Strong Q3 Earnings
COHR.content: AI-linked optical names sold off despite strong earnings. COHR -10%, LITE -7%, FN -8%. Market concerns about valuation after 2025 rally. Lumentum: demand far exceeds capacity; supply constraints to persist throughout 2026. Fundamentals remain strong.

LITE.title: Lumentum Q3 FY2026: Revenue $808M (+100% YoY) on AI Datacenter Demand; Supply Constraints Persist Through 2026
LITE.content: LITE Q3 FY2026: revenue doubled YoY to $808M. Management: demand across multiple product lines far exceeds capacity; supply constraints expected throughout 2026. Stock fell ~3% in after-hours despite strong results on broad optical sector selloff.

FN.title: Fabrinet Q3 FY2026: Revenue $1.21B (+39% YoY) on AI Optical Module Demand; Shares Fell 8% on Sector Rotation
FN.content: Fabrinet Q3 FY2026: revenue $1.21B (+39.3% YoY) driven by NVIDIA optical module manufacturing partnership and AI data center interconnect demand. Stock closed down 7.8% on broader optical sector rotation despite revenue growth.

MSFT.title: Microsoft Q3 FY2026 Earnings: Azure and AI Growing Strongly; 2026 Capex ~$190B for AI Infrastructure
MSFT.content: Microsoft Q3 FY2026 revenue $82.9B, earnings beat consensus. Azure cloud and Copilot AI products driving growth. Calendar 2026 capex expected ~$190B, three-quarters tied to AI infrastructure. OpenAI partnership deepening commercial AI monetization.

MSFT.title: Hyperscaler Capex Race 2026: Microsoft $190B, Amazon $200B, Alphabet $180-190B, Meta $125-145B
MSFT.content: Combined 2026 hyperscaler capex guidance from MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, META reaches $595-$635B, three-quarters earmarked for AI infrastructure. AWS grew at highest rate in 15 quarters. Google Cloud +63% YoY. AI monetization accelerating across all platforms.

MSFT.title: Microsoft Q3 FY2026: Azure +40% YoY, 20M Copilot Paid Seats (+250% YoY), AI Revenue Surpasses $37B Annual Run Rate; Agent 365 Launched
MSFT.content: Q3 FY2026: Revenue $82.9B, Azure grew 40% YoY, Microsoft 365 Copilot reached 20M paid enterprise seats (+250% YoY) — Accenture at 740,000 seats, largest customer win. AI business crossed $37B annual revenue run rate. Agent 365 launched May 1 as enterprise governance platform extending Microsoft 365 identity/security controls to AI agents. Intelligent Cloud segment $34.68B beat estimates.

GOOGL.title: Alphabet Q1 2026: Google Cloud Revenue +63% YoY; 2026 Capex $180-190B; Net Income Includes $37.7B Investment Gain
GOOGL.content: GOOGL Q1 2026: Google Cloud revenue +63% YoY. 2026 capex guidance $180-190B for AI infrastructure. GAAP net margin 56.9% includes $37.7B fair value gain on investment portfolio. Gemini AI integration driving Search and Cloud outperformance.

GOOGL.title: Amazon Ranked Best Hyperscaler Q1 2026 Report; Alphabet Cloud +63% Strong Runner-Up
GOOGL.content: Review of five hyperscaler Q1 2026 reports: Amazon ranked best overall on AWS reacceleration (highest growth in 15 quarters) and retail margins. Alphabet Google Cloud +63% ranked strong second. All five companies raised or maintained record capex plans.

GOOGL.title: GOOGL Hits All-Time High ~$402; Google Cloud First $20B Quarter (+63% YoY); Backlog Nearly Doubles to $460B
GOOGL.content: Alphabet shares hit all-time high ~$402 driven by Google Cloud's milestone first $20B quarter (+63% YoY). Cloud backlog nearly doubled sequentially to $460B. CEO Pichai: 'Cloud revenue would have been higher if compute supply met demand.' Gemini Enterprise paid MAUs +40% QoQ; 350M total paid subscriptions. Analysts note $190B capex plan may be 'already too small' for demand trajectory.

GOOGL.title: Google Cloud Next 2026: TPU v8 and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Unveiled; Processes 16 Billion Tokens/Minute
GOOGL.content: At Google Cloud Next 2026 (Las Vegas), Alphabet unveiled 8th-generation TPU v8 and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform targeting enterprise agentic AI. First-party Gemini API now processes 16B tokens/min (vs 10B last quarter — 60% QoQ increase). Platform positions Google Cloud as destination for enterprise AI-native architecture migration. Backlog and compute constraints signal multi-year demand expansion.

AMZN.title: Amazon Q1 2026: AWS Growth at Highest Rate in 15 Quarters; Revenue $181.5B; 2026 Capex $200B
AMZN.content: AMZN Q1 2026: revenue $181.5B, net margin 16.7%. AWS cloud computing grew at highest rate in 15 quarters. 2026 capex plan maintained at ~$200B (majority for AI infrastructure). Trainium/Inferentia custom AI chips scaling in commercial deployments.

AMZN.title: Amazon Rated Best Hyperscaler Q1 2026 Report: AWS Reacceleration + Retail Margin Expansion
AMZN.content: AWS growth reacceleration combined with retail profit margin expansion led analysts to rank Amazon as top Q1 2026 performer among hyperscalers. Anthropic investment and Trainium custom AI chips positioning AWS for long-term AI workload capture.

AMZN.title: Amazon Invests Additional $25B in Anthropic; Anthropic Commits $100B+ to AWS and 1GW Trainium2/3 Capacity by Year-End
AMZN.content: Amazon committed additional $25B investment in Anthropic (valuation $380B): $5B immediate + $20B contingent on milestones. Anthropic in return commits $100B+ to AWS over 10 years including 1GW of Trainium2/3 capacity by year-end 2026. Deal mirrors Amazon's earlier $50B agreement with OpenAI. Anthropic cited explosive Claude demand as driver of infrastructure urgency.

AMZN.title: Amazon Trainium Chip Backlog Surpasses $225B; Business Crosses $20B Annual Run Rate; OpenAI Commits 2GW Starting 2027
AMZN.content: AWS Trainium revenue commitments exceed $225B — part of $364B total AWS backlog. Trainium/Graviton/Nitro combined chip business crossed $20B annualized run rate (+40% sequential). OpenAI committed to 2GW Trainium capacity starting 2027; Anthropic up to 5GW. Trainium2 delivers ~30% better price-performance vs comparable GPUs; Trainium3 another 30-40% improvement.

META.title: Meta Q1 2026: Revenue +33% YoY (Fastest Among Hyperscalers); 2026 Capex Raised to $125-145B
META.content: META Q1 2026: revenue $56.3B (+33%), fastest growth among hyperscaler group driven by AI-powered ad targeting via Llama models. 2026 capex raised to $125-145B. MTIA custom AI chip scaling. Net margin 47.5%. One Big Beautiful Bill Act tax reform impacts being managed.

META.title: Meta Commits to 6GW AMD Instinct GPU Deployment; Confirmed as One of World's Largest AI Compute Buyers
META.content: Meta announced deployment of up to 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs including custom MI450. Combined with $125-145B capex, Meta is among the world's largest AI compute buyers. Llama open-source models and MTIA chips further deepen AI infrastructure vertical integration.

META.title: Zuckerberg Town Hall: Meta 2026 Layoffs Are Capex Reallocation to AI Infrastructure, Not AI Productivity Concerns
META.content: Mark Zuckerberg told employees that 2026 workforce reductions are budget reallocations toward AI infrastructure capex — not signals of AI replacing workers. Meta committed to $125-145B capex in 2026 (nearly double 2025), with nearly all directed to data centers, GPUs, and Llama model infrastructure. Meta Superintelligence Labs released its first model in Q1 2026. Stock initially fell ~10% on capex increase before recovering.

AAPL.title: Apple Q2 FY2026: Revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY), iPhone +22%; Apple Intelligence Driving Upgrade Cycle
AAPL.content: AAPL Q2 FY2026: revenue $111.2B (+17% YoY), EPS +22%. iPhone segment $57B (+22% YoY). Apple Intelligence AI features driving hardware upgrade cycle and Services growth. Gross margin 49.3%. Strong performance despite macro headwinds.

AAPL.title: Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft Trading at Best Valuations in Years Amid AI-Driven Earnings Growth
AAPL.content: AAPL, NVDA, MSFT trading at historically attractive valuations relative to earnings growth trajectory. Apple Intelligence hardware cycle, Services monetization, and M-series chip advantage in edge AI create multi-year earnings expansion case.

AAPL.title: Apple Authorizes $100B Buyback, Raises Dividend 4% to $0.27; Seeks Refund of Supreme Court-Struck IEEPA Tariffs; June Q Revenue Guide +14-17%
AAPL.content: Q2 FY2026 earnings: Apple's Board authorized $100B additional share repurchases and raised quarterly dividend 4% to $0.27/share (payable May 14, record date May 11). CEO Cook confirmed Apple pursuing refunds on IEEPA tariffs recently struck down by the Supreme Court, with refunds to be reinvested in U.S. advanced manufacturing above prior $500B commitment. June quarter revenue guided +14-17% YoY despite Mac supply constraints and tariff headwinds.

TSLA.title: Tesla Robotaxi Expands to Dallas and Houston; FSD Subscriptions Hit 1.28M (+51% YoY)
TSLA.content: Tesla Robotaxi went live in Dallas and Houston (April 18), expanding beyond Austin and Bay Area. FSD subscriptions reached 1.28M in Q1 2026 (+51% YoY). Management targeting a dozen U.S. states by year end. Large-scale unsupervised ramp remains 2027 per Musk on software architecture improvements.

TSLA.title: Piper Sandler: Tesla Optimus Robot Valued at Zero in Current ~$400 Stock Price; FSD/Robotaxi Key to Bull Case
TSLA.content: Piper Sandler analyst Alex Potter: Optimus humanoid robot effectively valued at zero in current ~$400/share price despite production ramp underway. Bull case anchored on FSD/Robotaxi scaling in 2027 and robot optionality on top.

TSLA.title: Tesla Optimus Factory Preparations Begin Q2: Fremont Line Targets 1M Robots/Year; FSD v14.3 Cuts Inference Latency 20%
TSLA.content: Tesla beginning preparations for first large-scale Optimus factory at Fremont (first-gen line: 1M robots/year) and Gigafactory Texas (second-gen: 10M robots/year long-term target) in Q2 2026. FSD v14.3 launched April with reinforcement learning upgrades, improved neural encoder, AI compiler, and 20% lower inference latency. Unsupervised Robotaxi now operating in Austin, Dallas, and Houston; targeting a dozen U.S. states by year-end.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Q1 2026: Revenue $2.1B (+112% YoY), Backlog $99.4B Approaching $100B; 2026 Guide $12-13B
CRWV.content: CRWV Q1 2026: revenue $2.1B (+112% YoY, +32% sequential). Backlog $99.4B (+50% QoQ). Active power surpassed 1GW; targeting 1.7GW by end 2026. 2026 capex guidance $31-35B. Full-year revenue guidance $12-13B maintained. Adj operating income $900M-$1.1B.

CRWV.title: CoreWeave Stock Falls ~10% on Wider-Than-Expected Loss Despite Record Backlog Near $100B
CRWV.content: CRWV stock fell ~10% post-earnings as Q1 EPS of -$1.11 missed -$0.87 estimate. Despite backlog approaching $100B and revenues tripling YoY, heavy capex ($31-35B in 2026) and persistent net losses concerned investors. Revenue guidance $12-13B for 2026 maintained.

CRWV.title: Magnetar Capital Sells $164.4M of CoreWeave Shares; Post-Earnings EPS Miss Raises Profitability Concerns
CRWV.content: Magnetar Capital funds disclosed $164.4M sale of CRWV shares following post-earnings ~10% decline. Q1 EPS of -$1.40 significantly missed -$0.87 estimate despite $2.1B revenue (+112% YoY) and $99.4B backlog. 2026 capex guidance $31-35B with persistent net losses raises investor concerns about path to profitability. Revenue guidance $12-13B for full 2026 maintained.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Q1 2026: EPS $2.74 Beats $2.59 Estimate; Revenue $11.12B; Calpine Drives Near-Doubling of Revenue
CEG.content: CEG Q1 2026: GAAP net income $1.59B (vs $118M a year ago), adj EPS $2.74 (vs $2.59 est). Revenue $11.12B (beat $9B estimate) thanks to Calpine acquisition consolidation in January 2026. Nuclear capacity factor 92.3%. Full-year adj EPS guidance $11.00-$12.00 affirmed.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy Freestone Site Approved for Large Data Center Co-Location; Pin Oak Creek 460MW Online
CEG.content: CEG Q1 update: Freestone site secured regulatory approval to co-locate a large data center, expanding nuclear power AI supply capacity. Pin Oak Creek 460MW natural gas facility reached commercial operation. 105MW Pastoria Solar commissioned.

CEG.title: Constellation Energy CEO Affirms 20% Long-Term EPS Growth Target; Ranked #1 on Barron's Most Sustainable U.S. Companies
CEG.content: Constellation Energy Q1 2026 earnings call: CEO affirmed 20% long-term earnings growth target. Ranked #1 on Barron's 2026 Most Sustainable U.S. Companies list. Nuclear PTC portfolio and AI data center power agreements provide multi-year revenue visibility.

VRT.title: Vertiv Q1 2026: Revenue $2.6B (+30% YoY), Adj EPS +83%; Full-Year Guide Raised to $13.5-14B
VRT.content: VRT Q1 2026: revenue $2.6B (+30% YoY, +23% organic), adj EPS +83%, adj operating margin 20.8%. Full-year 2026 guidance raised to $13.5-14B with 30% organic growth and 51% earnings growth. Backlog >$15B driven by AI data center liquid cooling and power demand.

VRT.title: Vertiv Stock Hits Record High as AI Demand Drives 80% Backlog Surge Year-Over-Year
VRT.content: VRT stock reaches record high after guidance raised to $14B. Backlog surged 80% YoY on AI data center liquid cooling and power infrastructure demand. Liquid cooling penetration rate inflection point a key long-term growth driver.

VRT.title: White House Invokes Defense Production Act: Power Grid as National Security — VRT, ETN, GEV Designated Beneficiaries for Accelerated Procurement
VRT.content: White House invoked Defense Production Act (April 20) classifying power grid and baseload energy systems as national security assets. Energy Dept authorized to accelerate procurement — direct purchases, guarantees, and regulatory approvals — for critical grid equipment. Vertiv (liquid cooling, power infrastructure), Eaton, and GE Vernova are primary beneficiaries. >50% of 2026 US data centers face delays from transformer/switchgear shortages.

ETN.title: Eaton Q1 2026 Record Revenue $7.5B (+17%); Data Center Orders +240% YoY; Electrical Backlog +48%; Raises Guide
ETN.content: ETN Q1 2026: record revenue $7.5B (+17%), adj EPS $2.81. Data center orders +240% YoY. Electrical backlog +48% YoY. Boyd Thermal acquisition closed March 2026 (liquid cooling, $1.7B+ 2026 revenue). Full-year organic growth guidance raised to +10% midpoint.

ETN.title: Eaton Boyd Thermal Acquisition Doubles Liquid Cooling Revenue; 12 New Factories Ramping for Data Center Demand
ETN.content: Boyd Thermal Q1 revenues more than doubled YoY adding liquid cooling to Eaton's data center portfolio. 12 new factories ramping (temporary margin headwind). Electrical Americas exit rate north of 30% margin targeted for H2 2026.

ETN.title: White House Defense Production Act: Power Grid Emergency — Eaton 11-Year Backlog, 50%+ of 2026 Data Centers Facing Delays
ETN.content: Defense Production Act designation of power grid as national security (April 20) accelerates federal procurement for electrical equipment. Eaton's data center electrical backlog equivalent to 11 years of 2025 construction activity. Industry data: >50% of planned 2026 U.S. data centers face delays or cancellations due to transformer and switchgear shortages — Eaton's core product categories. ETN up 17% YoY in Q1 2026.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Q1 2026: Revenue $9.3B (+16%), Orders $10B (+59% Organic); Backlog $163B; Data Center Orders $2.4B
GEV.content: GEV Q1 2026: revenue $9.3B (+16% YoY), orders $10B (+59% organic). Total backlog $163B (+$13B QoQ). Electrification segment booked $2.4B data center equipment orders in Q1 alone, exceeding all of 2025. Gas Power remains sold out. 2026 guidance raised.

GEV.title: GE Vernova and Vertiv Q1 Confirm AI Power Infrastructure Supercycle; $1.4T Needed for Data Centers by 2030
GEV.content: GEV and VRT earnings confirm AI power demand is structural. Industry projects $1.4 trillion in AI data center electrification by 2030. Grid equipment lead times and transformer availability remain supply-constrained, pricing power with GEV, ETN, VRT.

GEV.title: GE Vernova Up 65% YTD, Among Top S&P 500 Performers; Gas Turbine Slots Sold Through 2030; Targets 20GW Annualized Output Q3 2026
GEV.content: GE Vernova up 65% YTD, one of the strongest-performing S&P 500 industrials. Gas turbine slots sold out through 2030; targeting 20GW annualized gas turbine output by Q3 2026 and 24GW by 2028. Q1 data center orders $2.4B — more than all of 2025. Backlog $163B (+$13B QoQ). TIME magazine named GEV among 2026 Most Influential Companies. GEV per TIME: 'turning energy uncertainty into a business advantage.'

GEV.title: White House Defense Production Act: GE Vernova Gas Turbines and Grid Equipment Classified as National Defense Priority Assets
GEV.content: Trump White House invoked Defense Production Act (April 20) classifying power grid and baseload energy as national defense priority. Energy Dept can now accelerate procurement via direct purchases and guarantees for GEV gas turbines and grid equipment. GEV is the primary U.S. manufacturer for grid expansion — backlog $163B, turbine slots sold through 2030 — now with strategic federal procurement backing.

CCJ.title: Cameco Q1 2026: EPS $0.34 Beats $0.29 Estimate; EBITDA $509M; Annual Guidance Maintained Despite Flooding
CCJ.content: CCJ Q1 2026: net earnings $131M, adj EBITDA $509M, EPS $0.34 (beats $0.29 est). Revenue $607.5M beats forecast. Multi-year uranium delivery contracts average 28M lbs/year through 2030. Annual production and financial guidance maintained despite Saskatchewan flooding.

CCJ.title: Cameco Temporarily Halts Key Lake Production After Saskatchewan Flooding Collapses Bridge to McArthur River
CCJ.content: Flooding in northern Saskatchewan collapsed Smoothstone River Bridge, cutting supply access to McArthur River mine and Key Lake mill. Cameco temporarily halted Key Lake milling and reduced McArthur River mining activity. Long-term guidance unchanged; near-term production impact being assessed.

SMH.title: AMAT-TSMC $5B EPIC Center Partnership Signals Sustained Semiconductor Equipment Capex Supercycle
SMH.content: AMAT-TSMC EPIC Center partnership confirms sustained equipment capex. SMH portfolio companies — NVDA, TSM, AVGO, AMD, AMAT, KLAC, ASML — all benefit from AI infrastructure buildout. KLAC +2.89%, AMAT higher on announcement.

SMH.title: Semiconductor Sector Rotation: Intel (+200% YTD), AMD (+14% Post-Earnings) Lead; SMH Broadens AI Exposure
SMH.content: Semiconductor sector broadening AI rally beyond NVDA. Intel >200% YTD, AMD +14% post-Q1, Micron +700% TTM. Wall Street diversifying AI chip exposure across SMH's holdings — INTC, AMD, MU now among top performers in 2026.

XLU.title: AI Data Center Electrification Requires $1.4 Trillion by 2030; Nuclear and Gas Utilities Re-Rating Continues
XLU.content: Industry analysis projects $1.4T in AI data center electrification capex by 2030. XLU holdings Constellation Energy (CEG), NextEra Energy (NEE) and Duke Energy are key beneficiaries. CEG Q1 EPS beat, GE Vernova $2.4B Q1 data center orders reinforce structural power demand shift.

XLU.title: White House Defense Production Act: U.S. Power Grid as National Security — XLU Holdings CEG and NEE to Benefit from Federal Procurement
XLU.content: White House Defense Production Act invocation (April 20) adds federal backing to U.S. power grid expansion. XLU's top holdings — Constellation Energy (CEG, nuclear) and NextEra Energy (NEE, renewables/gas) — benefit from streamlined regulatory approvals and accelerated grid procurement. Combined with $1.4T projected AI data center electrification by 2030, structural tailwind for utilities sector is strengthening beyond historical rate-base growth.

COPX.title: Copper Supercycle Accelerates: AI Data Centers, EV, and Grid Upgrade Drive Demand; COPX Up ~154% TTM
COPX.content: S&P Global projects copper demand to roughly double through 2040 (+2.9% CAGR). Data center electrification is a major new demand driver per Freeport-McMoRan CEO. Supply side constrained by scarce discoveries and decade-long permitting. Tariff uncertainty peaked in 2025 with declining risk in 2026.

XME.title: Metals & Mining 2026: Tariff Relief Supports Outlook; AI Infrastructure Driving Copper, Steel, Aluminum Demand
XME.content: BMI Research: tariff uncertainty peaked in 2025 and declining in 2026 improves metals investment climate. XME trading $120.95 as of May 8. AI infrastructure buildout driving structural copper, aluminum, and steel demand; less cross-border trade risk encourages mining capex.

EWY.title: Foreign Capital Flows to Korean Chipmakers; EWY Up 87% YTD as SK Hynix and Samsung Dominate HBM Market
EWY.content: EWY up 87% YTD driven by SK Hynix (25.4% weight, primary HBM supplier to NVIDIA) and Samsung (24% weight). Foreign capital exiting broad KOSPI ETFs into targeted memory chip names. HBM now >30% of total DRAM revenue globally.

EWY.title: Samsung Electronics Unveils Next-Gen HBM4 Memory Targeting AI Accelerators; EWY Becomes AI Memory Proxy
EWY.content: Samsung unveiled HBM4 memory targeting AI accelerators to compete with SK Hynix's dominance. SK Hynix remains primary HBM3E supplier to NVIDIA. EWY has become a direct proxy for AI memory supercycle, with HBM and server DRAM driving earnings for both top holdings.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Q1 2026 Record: Revenue $200.4M (+63.5% YoY), Net Loss Narrows; Backlog $2.2B; Q2 Guide $225-240M
RKLB.content: RKLB Q1 2026: record revenue $200.35M (+63.5% YoY), net loss narrowed to -$45M. Backlog more than doubled YoY to $2.2B. Q2 guidance $225-240M (vs $207.5M estimate). Space Systems $136.7M, Launch $63.7M. 31 new contracts signed in Q1 alone, more than all of 2025.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Wins Expanded Anduril Hypersonic, Raytheon Space Force, and Motiv Space Systems Acquisition
RKLB.content: RKLB announced: largest launch contract to date, expanded hypersonic testing with Anduril, Space Force missile defense program with Raytheon, and acquisition of Motiv Space Systems for space robotics. 5 dedicated Neutron and 3 Electron launches contracted through 2029.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Shares Surge 8%+ Premarket on Record Revenue; Neutron Medium-Lift Rocket Program on Track
RKLB.content: RKLB stock surged 8%+ premarket after record Q1 2026 results. Neutron medium-lift rocket program advancing with 5 dedicated launch contracts through 2029. Defense sector expansion with Anduril and Raytheon diversifying revenue from commercial launches.

RKLB.title: Rocket Lab Neutron Timeline Risk: Tank Rupture Test Failure Pushes Launch to Q4 2026 / Early 2027; Archimedes Engine Tests Ongoing
RKLB.content: A Neutron upper-stage tank rupture during testing has pushed the initial launch target to Q4 2026 or potentially early 2027. CEO Peter Beck stated Archimedes engine is undergoing 'nasty' qualification tests and vehicle is 'on track for Q4 if engine survives.' Stage separation test completed successfully in May. Valuation now carries first-launch execution risk premium despite record $2.2B backlog and 31+ contracts in Q1.
